title: Inspect
description: A saved notebook, source or student copy, as the Python notebook functions see it.

source_error.description:
Why the notebook does not parse (`SourceError`). `assignment.assignment` lists it as
the problem; `export.package` warns that no answer could be read; `selfcheck.main`
exits with it.

config_error.description:
Why the config calls are invalid (`ConfigError`). `assignment.assignment` lists it as
the problem; `check._written_in_source` raises it.

config.description:
The config, `None` when `config_error` is set. `assignment.summary` titles the panel
with it.

problems.description:
What the build would refuse: `source.validate` and the data-file check
(`assignment._data_problems`). `assignment.assignment` lists them.

questions.description:
The config's questions in notebook order, empty without a config. `assignment.summary`
has a row per question; `check._written_in_source` reads `manual` by id.

answers.description:
The answer cells of each question a grade call names, in file order
(`Notebook.answer_cells`). `export.unanswered_lines` and `export.answers_markdown`
read them.

test_files.description:
The public test files that grade calls name (`selfcheck.test_files`).
`check.file_outcomes` and `selfcheck.public_results` run them; `selfcheck` fails the
unreadable ones.

public_job.description:
What `selfcheck.public_results` runs: the public phase of the notebook's bundle, then a
public cell for each readable test file, in `test_files` order. `None` when
`source_error` is set.

InspectConfig.description: The config fields the notebook functions use.

name.description: Assignment name. `assignment.summary` and `assignment._problems` title the panel.

InspectQuestion.description: One question of the config, with its tests and prompts.

points.description: Points, shown and added up by `assignment.summary`.

manual.description:
Whether it is graded by hand. `assignment.summary` shows it as written;
`check._written_in_source` reads it.

public.description:
Public test names in file order (`Notebook.tests_by_question`), counted by
`assignment.summary`.

hidden.description: Hidden test names in file order, counted by `assignment.summary`.

prompts.description:
The first line of each prompt cell of a written question (`source.prompt_previews`),
listed by `assignment.summary`.

Answer.description: One answer cell of a written question.

cell.description:
Cell name, e.g. `answer_q3` or `answer_q3_2`, which `export` looks its placeholder up
by.

text.description:
The Markdown of a cell that is just `mo.md("...")`, `None` for other code
(`source.answer_text`). `export` checks it against the placeholder and writes it.

source.description:
The cell's lines as written (`source.cell_source`). `export.answers_markdown` shows a
code answer, one whose `text` is `None`, as this source.

TestFile.description: A file of public tests that a grade call names as `test_file`.

qid.description: Question id of the grade call.

path.description: The path as the grade call gives it, relative to the notebook's folder.

tests.description:
Test function names in file order (`source.module_tests`), which `check.file_outcomes`
runs.

error.description:
Why the file cannot be read or parsed, `None` when it can. `check.file_outcomes` shows
it; `selfcheck.public_results` fails the file with it.

Bundle.description: Everything a grading child needs besides the submission.

config.description: The assignment config the grader needs.

setup_code.description: Body of the notebook's setup cell, run before the test cells.

helpers.description: Hidden cells without tests, in file order.

BundleConfig.description: The assignment config, without the host path of `requirements`.

notebook.description: File name of the source notebook.

files.description: Data files and folders shipped with the notebook, relative to it.

budget.description: Seconds for the whole grading run.

manual.description: Whether the question is graded by hand.

TestCell.description: One test cell of the source notebook.

qid.description: Question id of the cell's tests.

hidden.description: Whether the cell is marked `# HIDDEN`.

source.description: Cell body, run as a module.

tests.description: Test function names, in file order.

uses.description: Student names the cell refers to, bound from the submission.

needs.description: Names the cell reads from hidden helpers. Empty for public cells.

HiddenHelper.description: A `# HIDDEN` cell without tests, such as data or helpers for hidden tests.

source.description: Cell body, run as a module.

defines.description: Names the cell binds at top level.

uses.description: Student names the cell refers to, bound from the submission.

needs.description: Names the cell reads from other hidden helpers.
